name: upload-progress
title: Upload Progress
description: The arithmetic behind an upload time left: createRateEstimator (an EWMA of acknowledged bytes over 1 s ticks that ignores the first 3 s, reports after 5 s and 2%, and moves only on a 15% change), formatTimeLeft ("About 2 minutes left") and formatBytesProgress ("2.1 MB of 3.4 MB").

meta.whenToUse: An upload engine or surface that shows speed, time left, or bytes done of a total.
meta.whenNotToUse: Formatting a single size (formatBytes in file-kind) or a download progress you do not control.
